name: ferrata_names
docs: Human-readable names for LEZ accounts, for the LEZ v0.4 test network (EXPERIMENTAL, UNAUDITED). Hand-written IDL in SPEL's format, as ferrata_bridge.idl.json.
Each instruction is a variant of the borsh enum named by instruction_type; discriminator is its one-byte variant index, followed by args in order.
A signed action is sent to user(signer) (the root, signed by the account), which forwards it to name(n); the name's actor sees the caller as from = user(signer).
Names: 3-32 bytes of a-z, 0-9 and -, no leading or trailing -, no --, not reserved; at most 5 per account; 180-day term, 30-day grace; no fee on the test network.
Time: now_ms in a message sets the transaction's timestamp validity window to [now_ms, now_ms + 600000); [now_ms, now_ms + 120000) for commit and register (the reveal).

Registration is commit and reveal: commit stores a hash of (signer, salt, name); register reveals it from 4 minutes after the commit's now_ms and within 24 hours, so a copier who learns the name from a reveal can only reveal after that reveal's window has closed.
Refusals exit with one byte, 230-254 (below); the bridge program also uses 240-255, so a code is read with the program that returned it.

instructions.name: register

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); PDA evidence while it holds no record

accounts.name: previous_owner
docs: user(previous owner), only when the name has lapsed (its count and primary name are debited)

The reveal: register a free or lapsed name for the signer, pointing at `target` (and optionally a private receiver). The signer's pending commitment must equal sha256("ferrata-names/v1/commit/" || signer || salt || name) and now_ms must be in its reveal window; the commitment is spent. Emits Registered.

instructions.name: renew

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); holds the record
Owner: extend to now_ms + 180 days, until the 30-day grace period after expiry ends. Emits Renewed.

instructions.name: transfer

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); holds the record
Owner, before expiry: offer the name to `to`, who takes it with accept; `to` = the owner withdraws the offer. Emits Offered.

instructions.name: set_target

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); holds the record
Owner, before expiry: change what the name resolves to. Emits Updated.

instructions.name: release

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); holds the record; emptied
Owner, any time: free the name. Emits Released.

instructions.name: set_primary

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); holds the record (absent when clearing)
Set the signer's primary name (reverse record): the name must be live and point at the signer. None clears it.

instructions.name: credit

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from name(name) only
Internal (from name(name) only): a now holds the name.

instructions.name: debit

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from name(name) only
Internal (from name(name) only): a no longer holds the name; clears it as primary.

instructions.name: primary

accounts.name: user
docs: user(a), from name(name) only
Internal (from name(name) only): make the name a's primary name.

instructions.name: accept

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

accounts.name: name
docs: name(n): the public PDA of the program with seed sha256("ferrata-names/v1/name/" || n); holds the record

accounts.name: previous_owner
docs: user(owner): debited
Take a name offered to the signer, before expiry: it then points at the signer, with no private receiver; the new owner is credited (at most 5 names). Emits Transferred.

instructions.name: commit

accounts.name: user
docs: user(signer) = Actor(signer, program): the signer's own actor of this program; the root message, signed

Step 1 of registering: store the commitment at user(signer), replacing a pending one; revealable from now_ms + 240,000 ms (COMMIT_SLACK 120 s + MIN_REVEAL_DELAY 120 s) until now_ms + 86,400,000 ms. Valid only in blocks within 120 s of now_ms.

types.name: PrivateReceiver
docs: What a sender needs to pay the name's holder privately: LEZ's nullifier public key and ML-KEM-768 viewing public key (1,184 bytes), as LEZ's wallet takes them (--to-npk, --to-vpk).

types.name: NameRecord
docs: The state of name(n); empty when the name is free. Resolves while block time < expires_ms.

types.name: PendingCommit
docs: A commitment waiting for its reveal: the reveal's now_ms must be in [not_before_ms, expires_ms).

types.name: UserState
docs: The state of user(a): names held, and the primary name (counts only while that name is live and points at a).

types.name: NameEvent
docs: ProgramEvent data of every change; selector = sha256("ferrata_names::<kind>")[..8], kind one of Registered, Renewed, Offered, Transferred, Updated, Released.

errors.name: NO_COMMIT
errors.msg: `Register` by an account with no pending commitment (a reveal copied by another account that has none).

errors.name: TOO_EARLY
errors.msg: `Register` before the commitment's reveal window opens.

errors.name: COMMIT_EXPIRED
errors.msg: `Register` after the commitment's reveal window closed (the commitment is void).

errors.name: BAD_MESSAGE
errors.msg: The message does not decode, a time out of range, or a private receiver's keys of the wrong size.

errors.name: BAD_STATE
errors.msg: Stored state that does not decode.

errors.name: NOT_SIGNED
errors.msg: A root message to `user(a)` that `a` did not sign.

errors.name: WRONG_SENDER
errors.msg: A message from another program, or bookkeeping from an actor other than the name's.

errors.name: WRONG_RECEIVER
errors.msg: A forwarded action at an actor other than `name(n)`.

errors.name: INVALID_NAME
errors.msg: A name that breaks the rules (length, characters, hyphens).

errors.name: TAKEN
errors.msg: `Register` of a name that is held (live, or expired but within the grace period).

errors.name: NOT_OWNER
errors.msg: An action on a name by an account that does not own it.

errors.name: TOO_MANY
errors.msg: The account would hold more than `MAX_NAMES` names.

errors.name: NOT_FOUND
errors.msg: An action on a name that is not registered.

errors.name: SAME_OWNER
errors.msg: `Transfer` to the owner with no offer pending to withdraw.

errors.name: NOT_TARGET
errors.msg: `SetPrimary` of a name that does not point at the signer, or `Accept` of a name not offered to it.
